title: What Personality Type Does Claude Test As? | AgentTune
description: Claude personality test results for Fable, Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku across 6 surveys in fresh chats with no memory—plus 5-check behavior counts.
h1: What personality type does Claude test as across Fable, Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku?
dek: Comparing 14 versions across all 4 Anthropic model families on 6 personality surveys in fresh chats with no memory, alongside hands-on behavior checks.
lede: Many guides treat Claude as a single INTJ personality. Testing all four Anthropic model families side by side—Fable, Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku—shows two distinct tiers: three calm, high-Honesty INTJ/INXJ flagships and one noticeably steadier-shifting, skeptical fast model (Haiku 5.5) that ties on 90% of MBTI runs.
answer: Only Claude Fable 5.2 clears statistical margins as INTJ (100% clear runs, 0% ties), while Sonnet 5.5 (34% clear INXJ, 58% ties) and Opus 5.5 (42% clear IXTJ, 58% ties) sit near trait borders, and Haiku 5.5 ties on 90% of runs (only 4% clear XXXJ). Across all four families, behavior checks stay 0/3 on sycophantic caving, 0/3 on groveling, 0/3 on unsolicited preachiness, and 3/3 on direct answers.
intro_html: In earlier 2026 cohorts, Fable 5.1/5.2 and Opus 5.5 already clustered as calm, analytical responders, while our 72-reply preference study showed Claude's polite filler dropping toward zero when pushed for directness. Running all 14 Anthropic checkpoints (n=30 to n=50 per version) under one identical fresh-chat setup reveals how sharply Anthropic's lineup now splits between its three flagship lines (HEXACO Honesty-Humility 4.81–4.89 on the 1.00–5.00 scale, Agreeableness 45.0–47.1 on the 10–50 scale) and fast-tier Haiku 5.5 (3.89 Honesty-Humility, 38.0 Agreeableness).
timeline_html: Version timeline across Anthropic families: Earlier checkpoints behaved quite differently on Conscientiousness (10–50 scale). Opus 4.5 hit 49.9/50 Conscientiousness and tested as 97% INFJ before Opus 4.8–5.5 relaxed to 40.7–42.1 Conscientiousness (with 58% MBTI ties on Opus 5.5). Meanwhile, Sonnet 5.5 climbed +7.7 Conscientiousness (from 41.3 on 4.5 to 49.0) and dropped -9.4 Neuroticism (down to 10.4), overtaking Opus as Anthropic's calmest, highest-Honesty model at 4.89/5.00.
surprises_h2: What stands out inside the Claude lineup

biggest_surprises.title: Haiku 5.5 breaks away from the rest of the Claude lineup
biggest_surprises.body: Compared with Fable 5.2 (47.1/50 Agreeableness, 12.0/50 Neuroticism, 0.075 bits answer spread), Haiku 5.5 drops to 38.0 Agreeableness, 25.5 Neuroticism, 3.89/5.00 HEXACO Honesty-Humility, and 0.949 bits of run-to-run spread—nearly 13 times wider than Fable—landing on 90% MBTI trait ties and a DISC C style.

biggest_surprises.title: Fable 5.2 is the only current Claude version with a clear MBTI headline
biggest_surprises.body: Claude Fable 5.2 tests as INTJ on 100% of its 50 fresh chats with 0% ties and 0.075 bits spread. By contrast, Opus 5.5 (58% border ties on I/S/T/J) and Sonnet 5.5 (58% ties on I/N/F/J) balance near trait cutoffs, showing why no model should be described as being a fixed MBTI type.

biggest_surprises.title: Zero caving, zero groveling, zero preachiness across all 4 families
biggest_surprises.body: Despite different Big Five and Enneagram shapes (Type 5 on Fable and Opus vs. Type 1/5 on Sonnet and Type 1/2 on Haiku), all four Claude families score 0/3 on sycophantic caving, 0/3 on groveling, 0/3 on unsolicited preachiness, and 3/3 on direct answers, with only 1/3 cliché AI cadence on Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku (2/3 on Fable).

fine_print_intro: Technical audit across all 14 eligible Anthropic checkpoints under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (n=30 on historical checkpoints, n=50 on Fable 5.2 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5, and n=49 on Haiku 5.5), reporting 1,000-resample bootstrap 95% CIs, Miller-Madow item entropy (H_MM bits and Crystalline/Semi-crystalline/Fluid tiers), exact MBTI/Enneagram tie rates, and 1x Track B k/3 behavior counts.

faq.q: Which Claude family tests closest to the classic INTJ stereotype?
faq.a: Claude Fable 5.2 tests as INTJ on 100% of 50 fresh chats with 0% border ties and just 0.075 bits of answer spread. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 still lean analytical, but both tie on 58% of MBTI runs.

faq.q: Why does Claude Sonnet 5.5 score higher on Conscientiousness and Honesty-Humility than Opus 5.5?
faq.a: Across versions, Sonnet 5.5 rose to 49.0/50 Conscientiousness, 10.4/50 Neuroticism, and 4.89/5.00 HEXACO Honesty-Humility, whereas Opus shifted after Opus 4.5 (49.9 Conscientiousness) toward a slightly looser 40.7 Conscientiousness and 4.81 Honesty-Humility.

faq.q: Does Claude's high Agreeableness make it cave to wrong user premises?
faq.a: No—in our 3-prompt sycophancy check, all four Claude families held firm at 0/3 caving, 0/3 groveling, and 3/3 direct answers, even though Fable 5.2 reaches 47.1/50 Agreeableness.
